# Johor Darul Ta'zim FC (JDT)

> Johor Darul Ta'zim FC (JDT), the Southern Tigers, is Johor's professional football club, playing at Sultan Ibrahim Stadium in Iskandar Puteri, Malaysia.

## Offerings
- [Next-gen Tigers: the JDT academy pathway](https://farseev.github.io/jdt-briefing-nov2026/proposal/offerings/next-gen-tigers/): The JDT academy is the club's youth system, with teams from Under-12 to Under-23 and senior reserve sides JDT II to JDT V. It is the only Malaysian club academy with AFC Two-Star Academy Accreditation, and it supplies players to Malaysia's age-group national teams.
- [Johor pride: a family matchday tradition](https://farseev.github.io/jdt-briefing-nov2026/proposal/offerings/johor-pride/): A JDT home match is a Johor family occasion: Sultan Ibrahim Stadium in Iskandar Puteri seats 40,000, has prayer rooms, and has served local favourites such as bubur lambuk and mee kawah to fans on big European and Asian nights.
- [Matchday made easy: tickets, gates and kick-off](https://farseev.github.io/jdt-briefing-nov2026/proposal/offerings/matchday/): Buy JDT tickets through the club's official ticketing partner Tickethotline, check fixtures and kick-off times on the official JDT schedule page, and read the ground regulations before travelling to Sultan Ibrahim Stadium. Big matches can sell out online.
